reviews.text: This is THE cushion foundation. It’s hard to make it look cakey because of the puff absorbing a lot of the product, which makes cleaning the puff difficult in my opinion. I feel like it doesnt have a lot of product, the cap feels flimsy. It feels good on your skin though. It has a buildable coverage I’d say medium coverage.
reviews.zh: 呢款真係氣墊粉底嘅皇者。粉撲會吸晒好多產品，所以好難用到你塊面粉底浮起粉感，但同時清潔粉撲亦比較麻煩。感覺入面嘅粉底唔算好多，個蓋亦都好似唔太夠實。不過上面嘅感覺幾舒服。遮瑕度可以逐層疊加，大概係中度遮瑕。

reviews.text: In my opinion this cushion works much better than Tirtir and Sulwhasoo perfect cushion. It doesn’t have much coverage but the color stays up to 10 hours. The foundation melts to your skin with a little glowing. This is more for daily wear and for neutral look. Definitely not for anyone look for high coverage.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢款氣墊比起 Tirtir 同 Sulwhasoo 完美氣墊都好用好多。遮瑕唔算高，但係個色可以keep到十個鐘。粉底會融入皮膚，帶少少光澤感。比較啱日常用或者化個自然妝。搵高遮瑕嘅人絕對唔啱。

reviews.text: Bought this for my mom who really likes the natural finish, it is easy to use, doesn't oxidize and wears nicely throughout the day. This is a great option for those looking for a vegan-friendly medium coverage cushion.
reviews.zh: 買咗俾媽媽，佢好鍾意個自然妝效，容易用，唔會氧化變色，全日keep住都幾靚。對想搵一款純素、中度遮瑕氣墊嘅人嚟講係個好選擇。

reviews.text: It gives you the best results only if you prep your skin super well. If not enough skincare is done, you will experience extreme dryness and cracks. BUT!!! with the proper skincare, my skin does look super nice throughout the whole day.
reviews.zh: 一定要皮膚保養做得好好先用得最靚。如果保養做得唔夠，就會好乾仲會爆裂。不過！！！做好保養嘅話，皮膚真係成日都keep住好靚。

reviews.text: Good foundation, got shade 1.5 as a pale cool tone girlie; the shade pulls a little warm on me but workin in thin layers helps me. lasts all day w a skin like satin finish (i have normal/ drier skin)the formulation doesn’t feel drying; buildable coverage for darker eye circles and spots but has more of a medium coverage. overall good foundation, my favorite is the rom&nd water cushion and this is a good more matte option.
reviews.zh: 幾好嘅粉底，我皮膚偏白偏冷調就揀咗 1.5 色號；上咗之後個色喺我面上偏暖少少，所以用薄層慢慢上。Keep到成日，妝效似絲緞面嘅皮膚光澤（我係中性偏乾肌），質地唔覺得抽乾皮膚；遮瑕可以疊加深色眼圈同斑點，整體大概中度遮瑕。整體嚟講幾好，我最鍾意嘅係 rom&nd 水光氣墊，呢款就係比較霧面嘅好選擇。

reviews.text:
Even though i have a combination oily skin, I still find this cushion is abit dry to apply (I did prep with serum and moisturizer beforehand) for my skin. Its coverage is average, works okay for redness but definitely not for dark circles or anything wrose. 
After few hours, my skin gets abit oily again. Overall, it wasn't a good experience. I prefer my previous Black cushion from Hera.
reviews.zh: 雖然我係混合偏油肌，但用之前已經用咗精華同保濕霜打底，呢款氣墊對我嚟講都仲係偏乾難推。遮瑕一般，泛紅遮到少少，但黑眼圈或者其他問題就完全遮唔到。過咗幾個鐘皮膚又開始出返油。整體嚟講唔係一個好嘅體驗。我比較鍾意之前用過嘅 Hera 黑色氣墊。

reviews.text: Very drying. I have dry skin and it’s a bit patchy and can enhance my skin texture if I don’t prime right. Has coverage and looks like you’re wearing foundation, but doesn’t completely cover my redness and some prominent acne scars. Overall I prefer other Amuse cushions to this one for my skin. It will last on your skin for a long time! I have worn it for about 12 hours and it looked similar to when I first applied it.
reviews.zh: 非常乾。我係乾肌，唔打底嘅話會有少少斑駁，仲會突顯皮膚紋理。有遮瑕度，上完會睇得出有粉底感，但泛紅同幾個比較明顯嘅暗瘡疤都遮唔晒。整體嚟講我揀 Amuse 其他款氣墊多過呢款。不過持久度真係好長，試過戴住十二個鐘都仲keep到初初上妝嘅樣。

reviews.text: Bought it cause hoonion has been raving about it. It has a semi matte finish but isn’t dry upon application which is good as it gives you some time to apply it rather than drying down quickly. It has really good coverage but idk if I like it more than amuse’s dew power cushion yet which I love, maybe it would be better in the warmer months. Also, I’m super glad the color is more yellow compared to the meta fixing one which is too pink and drying
reviews.zh: 因為 hoonion 一直大推所以就買咗。半霧面妝效，但上妝時唔會即刻抽乾，所以仲有時間慢慢推開，幾好。遮瑕好好，但暫時未確定比起 Amuse 嘅水光氣墊更鍾意邊款，不過天氣熱啲用可能會更加啱。另外，好慶幸顏色比起 meta fixing 嗰款偏黃，嗰款太粉紅又太乾。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
